item.title: Spotify explores AI music interaction amid licensing challenges
item.description: Spotify has signalled its intention to allow listeners to interact with their favourite artists’ music using artificial intelligence, though licensing issues remain a key barrier. The comments were made by co-CEO Gustav Söderström during the company’s Q4 2025 earnings call on 10 February. Söderström outlined two categories for AI music on the platform. item.title: Boyz II Men announce SA tour dates for May 2026
item.description: South African fans of R&B are set to welcome the return of Boyz II Men, one of the world’s most acclaimed vocal groups, with a live tour scheduled for May. The Grammy-winning trio will perform on 27 May at the Grand Arena, GrandWest in Cape Town, followed by shows on 29 and 30 May at the SunBet Arena, Time Square, Pretoria. The concerts are expected to feature a selection of the group’s most iconic hits, including ‘End of the Road’, ‘I’ll Make Love to You’, ‘On Bended Knee’, and ‘Motownphilly’.

item.title: Open call: Global Music Awards 2026
item.description: The Global Music Awards has opened its annual entry period, inviting musicians from across the world to submit work for consideration in multiple categories. item.title: Vusi Khoza: An independent voice shaped by storytelling, experience
item.description: By Tshifhiwa Mungoni and Sibongile Kobo Born in Mpumalanga and now based in Katlehong, Vusi Khoza is an independent South African musician whose work centres on emotion, storytelling and lived experience. item.title: Hugh’s Jazz Club: A new blueprint for African jazz
item.description: Perched on the 13th floor of 73 Juta Street in Braamfontein, Hugh’s Jazz Club offers more than live performances. Opened in partnership with the Hugh Masekela Heritage Foundation, the venue operates as a self-sustaining ecosystem combining performance space, archival preservation, and funding for emerging artists. item.description: South African producer and DJ Sun-EL Musician has released his fourth studio album, Under the Sun, marking his latest project in a career that has spanned more than a decade in the country’s house music scene. item.title: Spotify launches “The Blend Date” with Kenyan creator Kevin Maina
item.description: Spotify has launched a new short-form series in Kenya, titled The Blend Date, in collaboration with digital creator Kevin Maina, also known as MainaMind. item.title: Spotify uses AI to write most of its code, CEO reveals
item.description: Spotify has revealed that its top developers have largely relied on artificial intelligence to write the company’s code since December, according to statements made during its Q4 2025 earnings call. item.title: Global Citizen announces Doja Cat as headliner for 2026 Move Afrika Tour
item.description: Global Citizen has announced that Grammy Award-winning artist Doja Cat will headline the 2026 edition of Move Afrika, its pan-African music touring initiative aimed at supporting the continent’s creative economy. The third edition of the tour will begin with Move Afrika: Kigali at the BK Arena on 17 March, followed by Move Afrika: Pretoria at the SunBet Arena, Time Square on 20 March.
